content.rendered:
Executive Women's Club

The worst place to find yourself is climbing a ladder with nowhere to go and no one to catch you, should you fall. -Ebony OH- Women historically have had fewer options than men-particularly when they're younger. No Worries! It's Our Time and It's Our Turn. We're getting ready to change this narrative for good!
GEC ACCELORATOR MEMBERSHIP INTEREST

Glass Ceiling
Breakers

Glass Ceiling Breakers

Today, only 23% of executive roles are held by women. The Garden’s Executive Club celebrates the women shattering glass ceilings everywhere.

LEARN MORE

Core Group

Core is The Garden's Executive Club's critically acclaimed peer group experience. This curated peer group of 10 career contemporaries forges deep connection, camaraderie, and support. Core groups convene monthly to confidentially work through challenges with a dedicated Core guide — a professional facilitator experienced in executive leadership development.

Salon Series

The Garden's Executive Club’s virtual events are designed to connect and inspire. Sessions include conversations with industry icons and workshops designed for senior leaders to sharpen their knives.

Connection

The Garden's Executive Club facilitates strong connections between leaders across industries. Members keep in close contact with their Core group and network with the entire community.

The Garden's Executive Club is a private network focused on connecting and supporting women leaders.

To be accepted, applicants must be C-level or a rising
VP. The Garden’s Executive Club is the only organization designed for women
seated at or around the table. Our members are rising
leaders making decisions today and influencing change
tomorrow.

APPLY

Global Domination

The Garden’s Executive Club is committed to providing a vehicle of impact amongst women world-wide. Membership is open in Georgia — with flagship clubhouse access in North Carolina.

The Garden's Executive Club was founded to drive women forward into positions of power — and keep them there. At the current rate of change, it will take over 200 years for women to reach parity in business. We’re not waiting eight generations.

“The end goal is that The Garden's Executive Club helps more women make connections and gain support to make it to the very top—budging the number of female CEOs on the Fortune 500, which currently stands at 25.”
“The private groups where C-Suite women go to power up”
“The Garden's Executive Club — a private club for women executives that helps them ascend to the top ranks and stay there.”
“The end goal is that The Garden's Executive Club helps more women make connections and gain support to make it to the very top”
“The glass ceiling cracked a little more with the creation of The Garden's Executive Club, a private network for aspiring or current female executives.”
